# TrueK Inspection

> TrueK Inspection sells certified vehicle history reports for used-car buyers in the United States. A single report costs $69 and is compiled from licensed data supplied by ClearVin and Black Book.

TrueK Inspection is a fully online service — there is no physical office or showroom. Customers submit a 17-character VIN through the website and receive a digital report. The company's legal registered name is TrueK Inspection.

## What a report includes

- Vehicle specification: make, model, year, trim, and factory-installed options decoded from the VIN.
- DMV title history: title brands such as salvage, rebuilt, flood, or lemon, and the states that issued them.
- Safety recall status: open manufacturer recalls tied to the VIN, sourced from NHTSA data.
- Online listing history: past for-sale listings found for the vehicle.
- Junk and salvage information: whether the vehicle was ever declared a total loss or sold for parts.
- Accident information: reported collision and damage history where available.

## Services

- [Request a Vehicle History Report](https://www.truekinspection.com/#report): Enter a VIN to generate a report.
- [Pricing](https://www.truekinspection.com/pricing): Flat $69 per report, one VIN per purchase.
- [Sample Report](https://www.truekinspection.com/sample): A completed example report to preview before buying.

## Data sources

Report data is licensed from ClearVin and Black Book. TrueK Inspection does not independently verify the underlying records — accuracy depends on what these providers, along with DMV and NMVTIS databases, have on file for a given VIN.
